title: ResponseAction
description: Schema for automated response actions triggered and reported by M3 (Automated Incident Response / SOAR-lite), consumed by M1 and M2 for session state updates. Version 1.0 – frozen for Phase 1.

session_id.description: Session identifier this action applies to.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this action was initiated.

action_type.description: Type of automated response action executed.

trigger_reason.description: Audit-log-ready description of what triggered this action (references policy_decision.reason).

status.description: Current execution status of the action.

metadata.description: Optional action-specific payload (e.g. alert ticket ID, MFA challenge reference).
